title: Audit the Chain.fm channel CA-first live pilot
objective: Independently and read-only verify that SOL-CHAINFM-CHANNEL-CA-LIVE-PILOT-001 froze exactly seven public Solana token CAs from the stated Owner-directed manual Chain.fm channel review, used one Helius-only bounded CA-first invocation, preserved strict Base58 and 32-byte validation before source construction, respected the at-most-three-lookups-per-CA and twenty-one-maximum-request boundary, and recorded only sanitized normalized evidence. Confirm that the report correctly marks all Chain.fm labels and displayed market-cap figures as borrowed and unverified, does not treat opaque Chain.fm account identifiers as Solana wallets, accurately reports the all-unavailable Helius transport outcome, and makes no holder concentration, creator/Dev, wallet PnL, win-rate, wallet-classification, scheduling or token-quality claim.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius, GMGN, Chain.fm or any network provider during this audit.
Do not inspect, print, save or record credentials, credential-bearing URLs, raw provider payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text or ignored Harness logs.
Do not automate, scrape, reverse engineer or bypass Chain.fm access controls.
Do not modify runtime source, tests, provider behavior, chain scope, automation, persistence, cache, queue, production infrastructure or the implementation acceptance report.

Do not reinterpret unavailable data or bounded token-account results as holder concentration, clustering, creator/Dev analysis, wallet PnL, wallet classification, token quality or a completed daily batch.
